notes.title: SNIPER ELITE V2 REMASTERED Launches May 14th - Upgrade Discount Confirmed
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34794722/b938a9df5da091198e4c7013030e0d0ae77678e3.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nKB1ioeA988

[h1]Independent developer and publisher Rebellion today announced an official release date for Sniper Elite V2 Remastered on Steam.[/h1]

The hotly anticipated remaster of the studio’s 2012 classic will launch on digital storefronts May 14th. Fans can pre-order [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] from today and take advantage of a special [b]10% discount[/b] on the digital edition ahead of launch.

[h1][u]Discount for owners confirmed![/u][/h1]
We are delighted to reveal that Steam users who already own the original edition of Sniper Elite V2 can upgrade to [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] for just [b]£6.99/$9.99/€9.99[/b].

[b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] features beautifully updated environments, characters, weapons and vehicles, modernized rendering and post-processing effects, enhanced texturing and level geometry, a revamped lighting system, and dozens upon dozens of improvements and refinements. 

In addition to visual upgrades, [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] introduces a brand new frame-by-frame photo mode, seven new playable characters from Rebellion’s Zombie Army series, expanded multiplayer for up to 16 players online, and all the additional content ever released for the game, [b]FREE[/b]. 

[b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] is available to pre-order from today for [b]£29.99/$34.99/€34.99,[/b] with a special [b]10% discount[/b] until launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/728740/Sniper_Elite_V2_Remastered/

For those enjoying our [b]Score Attack[/b] and [b]Horde Modes[/b] we bring to you extra [b]FREE[/b] maps to tickle your fancy and challenge even the most battle hardened Brigade members!

These include:

[h1][b]Score Attack: Harbin's Dig Site II![/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/1cec47c3476774c326a85b33ec69ad3df956588d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Score Attack: Hidden Valley II![/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/ae1a701160ac8e24584997de59cf9cb862ce4b9e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Score Attack: Tunnels of Wadjet II![/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/6ecaa2736943abc14c71e334c42f4cbcd2d02935.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]Horde Mode: Palace![/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/536268c00fe2b2d300da38a87e56b77d386e0361.jpg[/img]


[h1]Introducing to the [b]SEASON PASS[/b] the 6th member of the Strange Brigade - [b]Patrick 'Bash' Conaghan[/b]![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/5d3e3d8074b0b45bea00d8ee1a0fbdb7e1de912e.jpg[/img]

A much a brawler as an adventurer, his master gunslinger skills bless him with hefty headshots and an extra few rounds of ammo!

[b]DEFAULT LOADOUT[/b][list]
[*][b]Primary[/b]: Westminster 1895
[*][b]Secondary[/b]: Marley .45 Automatic
[*][b]Item[/b]: Dynamite[/list]
[b]DEFAULT AMULET POWER[/b]

Wrath of Quetzalcoatl: Bring down the Aztec fury of Quetzalcoatl and destroy your foes with electrifying efficiency!

[b]ATTRIBUTES & ABILITIES[/b]

Faster Explosives: Dynamite recharges quicker!

Super Headshot: Headshots are explosive!

[b]BACK STORY[/b]

[i]A rough-around-the-edges brawler and adventurer who has worked at various times as a rodeo rider, movie stunt man and oil industry roustabout. It was when gold prospecting in the Mexico Yucatan took a turn for the worse that he ran in to the Brigade, as a captive of a Mayan human sacrifice cult. Throwing his lot in with the brigade against his captors, Bash has stayed with them ever since, happy to go wherever there’s danger and treasure to be found[/i]. 

[b]Experiencing issues?[/b]

Please contact our Community Support team at [url]www.rebellion.co.uk/support[/url] for any technical issues.

notes.title: LAUNCH TRAILER - STRANGE BRIGADE ENLISTS FREE FIFTH CHARACTER AT LAUNCH!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/56e988f7137a6e835ab1e60639d9877faa0fe868.jpg[/img]

Would-be adventurers who acquire STRANGE BRIGADE when it launches next week will discover a rather resplendent treat – a FREE FIFTH CHARACTER!

Unveiled at the conclusion of today’s terrifically thrilling launch trailer, the gentleman explorer Winston Bey is now part of the Brigade! AND he’s FREE to all players who pre-order or purchase STRANGE BRIGADE on any platform during the first 30 days after launch.

[h1]Watch the Launch trailer[/h1] [url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZoDmSD_aBAI[/url]
Prospector, journalist, spy, diplomat and traveller – Winston Bey has explored the world and seen it all. He tells himself the Brigade’s adventures are “just an amusing diversion” in his extensive voyages, but the Department of Antiquities already has longer-term employment in mind…

STRANGE BRIGADE is so close you can practically taste the Earl Grey! Today’s splendid launch trailer heralds its arrival on August 28th, when Rebellion’s astounding adventure for 1-4 players launches for PC.

notes.title: Brand new modes announced!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/732ccaf65adc9fc846cd08e433e6645dc072c973.png[/img]

With just three weeks until the launch of Strange Brigade, we’re excited to lift the sarcophagus lid on two very exciting surprises: [b]Score Attack and Horde Mode![/b]

These two modes – playable in single-player or two-four player – will be available [b]FREE[/b] at launch, and we’re delighted to confirm that both will receive free content updates post-launch!

So what are these modes? Read on adventurer, and find out…

[h1]SCORE ATTACK – WHERE SPEED MEETS PANACHE…[/h1]
Score Attack is a fast-paced mode, all about cutting through large numbers of enemies with as much speed and style as you can, in an attempt to keep that combo-multiplier as high as possible! As you might expect, this ticks up as you take down your enemies in quick succession, but will deplete should you take too long to score a kill!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/81d7a01c6552ec701e6613add44053e6aac56bbe.jpg[/img]

As well as this, there are also big bonus points up for grabs – such as not taking any damage, racking up the headshots, and other devilish challenges to keep you coming back for more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/cf1ab10dda9d07183d20e8e4f0118c00f8715a9d.jpg[/img]

We cannot wait for you try Score Attack – it’s a fast-paced challenge with plenty of opportunities to show off your skills!

[h1]HORDE MODE, WITH A ‘STRANGE’ TWIST![/h1]
Horde Mode may seem familiar at first, but the crack team at Rebellion worked their magic to take some of the core gameplay mechanics and reinterpret them in to a fresh new mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/36550a9f513d0afa6ae6834fd96c571b6ad11309.jpg[/img]

Similar to spending gold in the campaign to unlock new weapons, special weapons and more, in Horde Mode you accumulate gold by killing enemies – but how do you spend it? Do you splash the cash on the Flamethrower, knowing once it runs out of gas it’s done, or do you save your gold to open up new parts of the level to potentially unlock more goodies like health potions or loot? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/544fe9f8168fb9ad097554f623277152ee915a28.jpg[/img]

This neat change helps to create a thrilling mode, whether you’re playing solo or with 2-4 players, full of tactical decisions to be made in the face of an unending horde of nefarious ne’er do wells…

[h1]IN THE NEXT EXCITING EPISODE OF THE STRANGE BRIGADE…[/h1]
There you go, keen adventurers. We’re thrilled to be able to show this off and we can’t wait for you to get playing! Check out the brand new screenshots to get your first taste of Score Attack and Horde mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/e8b82774a443888b208cfdd65337e2e6f84aff2d.jpg[/img]

Which mode are you most excited for? Come and join the conversation on [url=https://twitter.com/StrangeBrigade] Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/strangebrigade/] Facebook[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/rebellion] Discord[/url]

Have no fear - the intrepid and dashing [b]STRANGE BRIGADE®[/b] set off for rip-roaring escapades on [u]August 28th![/u] Rebellion's new 1930s co-op adventure is now available for pre-order including Collector's and Digital Deluxe editions. 
 
As today's brand new story trailer reveals, our four heroes find themselves in exotic, unplumbed corners of Egypt, where ancient terror lingers. Risen from the dead, the Witch Queen Seteki commands an army of mummified monstrosities hell-bent on terror, and only one band of brave adventurers has the gusto to sock ancient evil back into its sarcophagus! Together, the [b]STRANGE BRIGADE®[/b] must take on treacherous traps, overcome puzzling predicaments and blast their way through hordes of malevolent monsters in a thrilling campaign for 1-4 players. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kr2F56a.jpg[/img]

[h1]PRE-ORDERS & FREE CONTENT[/h1]
Would-be adventurers can pre-order [b]STRANGE BRIGADE®[/b] starting today. All pre-orders will include the [b]Secret Service Weapons Pack FREE[/b], including the butter-smooth [b]Wilkers & White P19 pistol[/b], the piercingly precise [b]Stoudenmire 960[/b] submachine gun, and the punch-packing, one-of-a-kind [b]Gehrig-Delgane S1[/b] rifle.  
 
Digital discoverers can also pre-order the [b]STRANGE BRIGADE®[/b] Deluxe Edition, featuring the game and Season Pass in one great value-for-money bundle. Post-launch Season Pass content will include new campaign missions, characters, weapons, items and more.

[b]About Rebellion®[/b]
Founded in 1992, Rebellion is one of Europe's leading independent game developers and publishers. Whether it's the breathtaking intensity of [b]Sniper Elite 4[/b], the face-hugging terror of [b]Aliens vs. Predator[/b] or the grindhouse frenzy of [b]Zombie Army Trilogy[/b], the Oxford-based studio is known for creating stand-out games that thrill players.
